problems.title: 3Sum
problems.notes: Sort the array first, then use two pointers. Beware of duplicate triplets!

problems.title: Valid Parentheses
problems.notes: Classic stack problem. Push opening brackets, match when closing encountered.

problems.title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
problems.notes: Sliding window with set / index map. Update left pointer when duplicate seen.

problems.title: Trapping Rain Water
problems.notes: Two-pointer approach using left_max and right_max bounds. Must re-solve next week!

problems.title: Merge Two Sorted Lists
problems.notes: Dummy head node simplifies pointer manipulation.

roadmap.title: Arrays & Strings Mastery
roadmap.description: Fundamental memory layouts, two pointers, prefix sums, and sliding window techniques.

roadmap.title: Searching, Sorting & Stacks
roadmap.description: Binary search variations, quick/merge sort concepts, and monotonic stacks/queues.

roadmap.title: Linked Lists & Fast-Slow Pointers
roadmap.description: Reversal, cycle detection (Floyd's algorithm), LRU Cache, and merge sorting on lists.

roadmap.title: Binary Trees & BST
roadmap.description: Tree traversals (Inorder/Pre/Post/Level), LCA, diameter, and binary search tree properties.

roadmap.title: Graphs: BFS, DFS & Shortest Paths
roadmap.description: Adjacency representations, topological sort, Dijkstra, Union-Find (DSU).

roadmap.title: Dynamic Programming & Backtracking
roadmap.description: 1D/2D memoization vs tabulation, knapsack, LCS, LIS, and state-machine DP.
